Answer: D
Reason: The provided CT images (Figures 1a-c) demonstrate a right-sided pleural effusion, right lung atelectasis/hypoplasia, and an anomalous venous structure draining into the IVC/right atrium region, which are hallmark features of Scimitar syndrome (partial anomalous pulmonary venous return). Although the question references a chest X-ray, these cross-sectional findings confirm the diagnosis implied by option D.
